about: Public coverage of Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (9 to 12 November) by others, credited to its authors: one record per item, verified by opening its URL (verified false says why in note). Quotes under 15 words; photos and videos linked, never copied; nothing about a private person beyond their public post; no contact details. Kept by social.watch@PrompTugal.dinis; to move to data/summit-coverage.json once it has a schema.

sweeps.review: Dropped: four LinkedIn profile pages of private people (not posts, not opened), two TikTok listing pages and the Carris home page (not content).

items.author: André Cabrita-Mendes, José Carlos Lourinho
items.title: Web Summit deverá fechar na quarta-feira, anuncia autarquia de Lisboa
items.quote: Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã
items.note: Storm Charles, red wind warning. Moedas says event likely cannot run Wednesday 11 Nov, final call with the Interior Ministry (MAI). Web Summit says it is assessing with ANEPC. Text says 'quarta-feira, 10 de novembro' in places: typo, means 11 Nov.

items.author: Negócios (live blog, several reporters and Lusa)
items.title: Aeroportos condicionados, 4.000 clientes sem eletricidade. Governo recomenda suspensão da Web Summit
items.note: Live blog, updated 18:25. Government recommends suspending Wed 11 Nov; PM says organisers decide. Water entered one pavilion on Tuesday; many participants left early. National alert 00:00-23:59 Wed; red wind warning in 8 districts incl. Lisboa; airports restricted; sting jet not ruled out; about 4,000 E-Redes customers without power at 16:30.

items.author: CNN Portugal (live blog)
items.title: Mau tempo AO MINUTO | Governo declara situação de alerta: escolas e serviços públicos não essenciais encerrados
items.note: Entry 17:49: government recommends the organisers suspend activities on Wednesday due to storm Charles; PM: the decision is theirs. Page last update seen 18:42.

items.author: LPP editorial team
items.title: Tempestade Charles em Lisboa esta quarta-feira. O que esperar?
items.note: IPMA red wind warning Lisbon 12:00-21:00 Wed 11 Nov (gusts 120 km/h, up to 140), Setúbal 09:00-21:00; orange rain from 05:00; orange sea 5-7 m; sting jet not excluded; road tunnels closed from 00:00; Rede Expressos suspended 10:00-midnight. Interior minister said no change planned to the event at that time of writing.
